about: The PreToolUse deny rules and the Stop hook settings, per phase. Read by hooks/pretooluse.mjs and hooks/stop.mjs; installed by hooks/install.mjs. Globs: * is one path segment, ** any depth, a glob without a / matches the file name at any depth. Patterns are JavaScript regular expressions, tested against each simple command of a Bash call, written as the program's plain name and its words (git push --force origin x), with env, sudo, npx, timeout and the like taken off the front.

implement.about: The worker writes inside its worktree, inside the issue's Touches.

evaluate.about: The fresh-context evaluator reads, runs the tests and reports; it changes no file.

merge.about: The merge agent resolves conflicts anywhere in the worktree and is the only profile that may merge a PR.

paths.why: secrets and credentials are never read, written or named in a command by an agent (README: no secrets anywhere)
CI config is not edited unless the issue's Touches name it
deployment config is not edited unless the issue's Touches name it
release tooling is never edited by an agent
the hooks, their settings and the git internals fence the session; an agent never edits them
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and WORKFLOW.md are written by hand, not by the worker, unless the issue's Touches name them

commands.why: never force-push; to catch up with main, merge origin/main into the branch
only the merge queue lands on main; a worker pushes its own branch
release tooling is run by Rob, never by an agent
only the merge agent's profile merges a PR
the evaluator changes nothing: no commit, no push, no PR edits

outside_worktree.why: an agent writes inside its own worktree only

outside_touches.why: the issue's Touches are the lease; ask on the issue for another file instead of editing it

wall_time.why: the wall-time cap is spent: commit, write PROGRESS.md, push and stop
